Score GDHI Maturity Phases Across Components and Overall Ecosystem

gdhi_score_maturity.Rd

Validates 1–5 indicator scores against gdhi_indicator_dictionary() and computes component-level and overall digital health maturity phases.

Usage

gdhi_score_maturity(
  data,
  id_col,
  round_phase = TRUE,
  include_subindicators = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame or tibble containing an entity identifier column and indicator score columns matching indicator_id values from gdhi_indicator_dictionary() (for example IND_01, IND_02, ..., IND_19, and optional sub-indicators like IND_09A or IND_19A).

id_col

Name of the entity/country/region identifier column (unquoted).

round_phase

Logical; if TRUE (default), rounds component and overall mean phases upward using ceiling(), matching GDHI phase aggregation conventions. If FALSE, returns unrounded numeric means alongside raw scores.

include_subindicators

Logical; if TRUE (default), includes sub-indicator columns present in data when averaging within their parent indicator or component. If FALSE, uses core indicators only.

Value

A tibble with id_col, component_number, component_name, component_mean, component_phase, and overall_score (or unrounded overall_raw_mean when round_phase = FALSE).

Examples

sample_df <- tibble::tibble(
  entity = c("Country_A", "Country_B"),
  IND_01 = c(4L, 2L),
  IND_02 = c(4L, 3L),
  IND_03 = c(3L, 2L),
  IND_04 = c(3L, 1L),
  IND_13 = c(3L, 2L),
  IND_14 = c(3L, 1L),
  IND_15 = c(4L, 2L),
  IND_16 = c(3L, 2L),
  IND_17 = c(4L, 2L)
)
gdhi_score_maturity(sample_df, id_col = entity)
#> # A tibble: 10 × 8
#>    entity    component_number component_name         n_indicators component_mean
#>    <chr>                <int> <chr>                         <int>          <dbl>
#>  1 Country_A                1 Leadership and Govern…            2            4  
#>  2 Country_A                2 Strategy and Investme…            2            3  
#>  3 Country_A                5 Standards and Interop…            2            3  
#>  4 Country_A                6 Infrastructure                    2            3.5
#>  5 Country_A                7 Services and Applicat…            1            4  
#>  6 Country_B                1 Leadership and Govern…            2            2.5
#>  7 Country_B                2 Strategy and Investme…            2            1.5
#>  8 Country_B                5 Standards and Interop…            2            1.5
#>  9 Country_B                6 Infrastructure                    2            2  
#> 10 Country_B                7 Services and Applicat…            1            2  
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: component_phase <int>, overall_raw_mean <dbl>,
#> #   overall_score <int>
